principle: No outside VIVIM repository wiring; full beta assembled from internally imported working source without wholesale rewrite.

gates.title: Freeze source import list
requirements: All selected donor branch and subtree SHAs pinned
No credentials/user data in imported source
Every active incumbent runtime owner classified

gates.title: Self-contained workspace
requirements: All selected Tauri, Host, Studio, PWA, HQ JS, HQKG Rust and TierFlow source inside ARBOR
Cargo/Bun builds from ARBOR only
No external Git/submodule/path runtime dependencies

gates.title: Native HQKG
requirements: Imported HQKG source and tests pass
Development/Personal graph namespace restrictions verified
One canonical graph crate in release

gates.title: HQ operations internal
requirements: In-repo HQ index/search/context/wiki run on synthetic local project
No external HQ process/database/path necessary
Source SHA, index freshness and permission scopes preserved

gates.title: Host effects
requirements: One current Host catalog and authoritative journal
Approval/claim/receipt/uncertain-send behavior verified
No independent Rust or UI effect writer

gates.title: Node 0 safe path
requirements: IME/text remains locally responsive
Bounded native event work, stale revision refusal
Typed actor and source scopes; Tab cannot cause effect

gates.title: Native security
requirements: Patched supported Tauri v2 manifest and lock
Exact native IPC origin scopes
Host child listener identity verified before owner token transfer

gates.title: Studio browser
requirements: Real signed-in supported provider conversation through ARBOR
Source/target thread evidence and explicit send fencing
Browser failure does not block local editing

gates.title: Paired PWA
requirements: Real physical phone pairs and revokes
Phone input uses same Host authority and semantic identifiers
Offline/stale state never grants effects

gates.title: TierFlow UI
requirements: Selected TierFlow source builds internally
Single source-backed visual publisher
Desktop and PWA status source identities compatible

gates.title: Capabilities and Labs
requirements: Every selected Labs component has source SHA/status/owner/target
Working incumbent capabilities preserved or explicitly scope-approved
Generated capability status distinguishes preview from available

gates.title: World and storage
requirements: Owner data export/backup/restore integrity
Rock Core protected from cache compaction
HQ dev index separate from private World and bounded disk

gates.title: Zero outside wiring
requirements: No donor repository checkout needed
No donor process, server or SQLite file needed
Self-contained release works with donor folders removed or renamed

gates.title: One beta release
requirements: Windows package and PWA version compatible
Exactly one live Host effect writer after cutover
Rollback tested with in-flight/uncertain receipts reconciled
